policy_rules.rule: After all five x1 lane prompts are sent, do not manually check lane status or artifact upload state until the 15-minute cadence gate unless a watcher emits a blocker receipt.
After x2 prep starts, do not perform manual lane status checks until the 10-minute prep gate unless a watcher emits a blocker receipt.
Use waiting windows for research, reflection, task design, next-phase planning, source-ledger refresh, runner hardening, and approval-packet preparation.
Completion requires watcher, notifier, final-marker, app-lane, CLI-lane, or normalized-board receipt evidence; waiting time alone is not completion proof.
Publish only status fields, hashes, byte counts, word counts, timing, and policy outcomes; do not publish raw lane text, raw app transport, screenshots, credentials, or private dumps.

watcher_repair_escalation: If a lane misses a cadence gate, keep the sibling on the roster and route the gap into stale-flow repair.
If a watcher emits sensitive-material risk, pause publication and run exposure guard before staging.
If CLI output is ready but generic markers appear, run strict marker review before treating the result as blocked.
